name: National Science Chair- Scientific Excellence
benefit:
1. An amount of ₹1.5 lakhs per month will be given to the awardee as a fellowship.
   1. The Research Grant in this case will be ₹25 lakhs per annum.
   1. For overhead expenses, ₹1.0 lakh per annum will be given to the host institution.

**Note:** The grant shall be used for manpower, equipment, travel (including international), contingency, etc. It needs to be utilized as per the norms of the Ho
_eligibility_text:
> **Eligibility for nomination:**

   1. The nominee should be an active resident Indian scientist/academician, with an outstanding research track record in any one or more areas of STEM and medicine, particularly during the last five years.
   1. The nominee must have received recognition for his/her work from national/international scientific bodies such as fellowship in prestigious academies and S&amp;T awards.
   1. The nominee could be affiliated with an academic institutions/R&amp;D lab or should have consent on the subject from the future host institution.

**Note:** The nominee should not hold any administrative roles and functions and is not in receipt of any honorarium/fellowship/salary from any other institute or organization at the time of initiation of the NSC award if offered by SERB. 
> **Assessment Criteria:** The assessment criteria for the selection of the awardee will be decided by NSCAC and it will be generally based on the following considerations:

   1. Outstanding research track record of the nominee and international standing in the field.
   1. Quality/originality of proposed research plan.
   1. Ability to mentor young researchers and implement proactive approaches towards the advancement of S&amp;T talent in the country.
